title_zh: 国行 Apple 智能开启测试，Siri、写作工具与视觉智能接入千问
content_zh:
今天凌晨，苹果推送 iOS 27.3 首个开发者测试版，国行「Apple 智能与 Siri」开始开放体验。

苹果中文官网列出的首批功能包括写作工具、实时翻译、照片消除、智绘表情及通知摘要。

千问被整合进 Siri、视觉智能和写作工具，用户可在系统内提问、生成文本或处理图像。

据爱范儿实测，视觉智能的以图搜物还接入了百度搜索。Siri 换上环绕屏幕边缘的光晕，并支持双击屏幕底部切换为文字输入。

在 Siri 中，基础问答可直接完成。以「最近总是睡不好」为例，Siri 会调用千问给出通用睡眠建议。

如需更个性化的方案，用户可点击千问 Logo 跳转至千问 App，对话信息会自动同步。据了解，千问可结合用户此前的睡眠记录、运动情况和生活习惯制定改善方案。

实时翻译覆盖信息、电话和 FaceTime，其中电话与 FaceTime 限一对一通话。AirPods 翻译需适配耳机更新至最新固件，并与启用 Apple 智能的 iPhone 配对。

首批功能适用于 iPhone 15 Pro 系列、iPhone 16 全系列及后续机型，以及 iPhone Air、iPhone Duo，Siri 和设备语言须设为简体中文或英语。

值得注意的是，此次国行更新提供的是首批 Apple 智能功能，WWDC 2026 预告的新版 Siri AI 未包含在内。

🔗 相关阅读：连夜实测 iPhone 国行 AI，亮点和槽点都在这了
title_en: Apple Intelligence Beta Launches in China, Integrating Alibaba’s Qwen Model
content_en:
Apple has released the first developer beta of iOS 27.3, officially bringing Apple Intelligence features to users in mainland China for testing. The initial localized suite of tools includes Writing Tools, Live Translation, Clean Up in Photos, Genmoji, and Notification Summaries.

To tailor the experience for the Chinese market, Apple has integrated Alibaba’s Qwen language model into Siri, Visual Intelligence, and Writing Tools. Users can leverage Qwen directly within the system to generate text, process images, and handle complex queries. Siri handles basic questions via Qwen automatically, offering seamless handoff to the standalone Qwen app for personalized recommendations. Additionally, Visual Intelligence's image search feature incorporates Baidu Search.

The update supports devices starting from the iPhone 15 Pro series, the entire iPhone 16 lineup, and newer models such as iPhone Air and iPhone Duo, provided the language is set to Simplified Chinese or English. This initial release focuses on core Apple Intelligence features, while the next-generation Siri previewed at WWDC 2026 will arrive in a future update.

title_zh: 苹果天气出现数据异常，多地下周五「跌至」零下 32 度
content_zh:
向左滑动查看更多内容

今天凌晨，苹果自带天气 App 在国内多个城市出现预报数据异常，将下周五（11 月 13 日）的最低气温错误显示为 -32℃ 左右。

受影响的区域覆盖北京、上海、南京、武汉、合肥、福州、西安、昆明等多个城市，页面显示的极端低温普遍集中在 -29℃ 至 -33℃ 区间。

例如昆明地区页面显示当日最低气温将在 19:00 至 20:00 骤降至 -32℃，而白天最高气温仍显示为 17℃ 至 24℃，单日昼夜温差接近 50℃。与此同时，广州、深圳、南宁、海口等两广及海南地区的天气预报显示正常，并未出现类似数据。

中央气象台及各地气象部门近期并未发布寒潮预警，国内外主流数值预报模式亦未预测 11 月 13 日前后会有剧烈降温天气。

有气象博主分析指出，异常显示的时间节点恰好处于北京时间 20:00（世界协调时 12:00）的数值模式预报节点，推测系该时次的预测数据出现偏差后经算法插值放大所致。
title_en: Apple Weather Glitch Predicts Extreme -32°C Plunge Across Major Chinese Cities
content_en:
A severe data glitch hit Apple’s native Weather app early this morning, displaying wildly inaccurate low temperatures of around -32°C for next Friday across multiple major cities in China.

The issue impacted major urban centers including Beijing, Shanghai, Wuhan, Nanjing, Xi'an, and Kunming, with forecasted lows universally plunging into the -29°C to -33°C range. In Kunming, the app displayed a pleasant daytime high of up to 24°C alongside a night drop to -32°C, representing an impossible daily temperature fluctuation of nearly 50°C. Southern coastal regions like Guangdong and Hainan remained unaffected.

National meteorological authorities have issued no cold wave warnings, and global prediction models show no severe cold fronts approaching. Weather analysts suggest the error occurred during a routine numerical model update, where localized prediction anomalies were unintentionally amplified by data interpolation algorithms.

title_zh: 苹果向所有开发者开放 Siri AI，可将多个 App 动作串成任务
content_zh:
苹果宣布，随 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 和 visionOS 27.3 测试版开放新的 Siri AI 开发者预览，所有开发者均可通过 App Intents，将应用中的内容与操作接入新版 Siri。

接入后，Siri AI 能结合个人上下文、屏幕内容和自然语言请求执行应用内动作，例如查配送、订位或下单。苹果还引入「技能」，允许开发者把多个操作组合为一次完整体验，并让 Siri AI 检索 Spotlight 语义索引中的实体。

日历、文件、访达、邮件、地图、信息、照片等 15 款苹果应用已开始提供相关能力，例如寻找上周去过的咖啡店、归档超过一年未打开的文件。苹果称，这批接口将先供开发者探索，几个月后开始面向用户交付，明年春季开放 App Store 提交。

当前 Siri AI 测试版要求支持 Apple 智能的设备及受支持语言；简体中文不在当前语言列表中，繁体中文、挪威语、土耳其语和越南语将随后加入。
title_en: Apple Opens Siri AI Preview to All Developers, Enabling Multi-App Workflows
content_en:
Apple has expanded access to its next-generation Siri AI with a new developer preview across the iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS 27.3 betas. By leveraging updated App Intents, developers can now integrate their apps' internal actions and content directly into Siri.

With awareness of personal context and onscreen content, Siri AI can execute complex in-app tasks like checking delivery statuses or placing orders. Apple also introduced a "Skills" framework, allowing developers to chain multiple actions together into single automated workflows and enabling Siri to query entities via Spotlight semantic search.

Fifteen native Apple apps—including Calendar, Mail, Maps, Messages, and Photos—already showcase these features. Developers can begin testing the APIs immediately, with consumer rollout planned over the coming months and App Store submissions opening next spring. The preview requires Apple Intelligence-supported hardware, though Simplified Chinese is currently excluded from the supported language list.

title_zh: GPT 爆改 Qwen 权重，团队测试数学成绩提升约 6 倍
content_zh:
MIT CSAIL 博士生 Rikiya Takehi 及合作者公布「权重空间编程」实验：让 GPT-6 Astra 直接读取、修改 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的权重，不使用梯度下降或训练循环。在团队的 MATH-500 测试中，修改后模型的平均准确率由 7.9% 升至 48.1%，约为原来的 6 倍。

实验向 Astra 提供权重操作用的 Python 环境，以及不含测试集题目的数学练习材料。效果最好的这一轮允许最多 50 次前向调用，供模型检查生成结果和内部状态；最终编辑涉及约 0.016% 的权重。团队称，Astra 找到并削弱了使小模型陷入重复推理的方向，集中修改第 15 层和第 19 层的部分 MLP 输出列。

同一轮测试中，GSM8K 准确率由 13.8% 升至 67.1%，IFEval 严格指令遵循准确率由 21.0% 升至 62.3%。团队已公开实验提示、代码、评测和权重差分；作者随后还分享了重建后的模型及在线演示。

🔗 相关阅读：GPT-6 Astra 爆改 Qwen 大脑：只动 0.016% 参数，数学成绩疯涨
title_en: GPT-6 Astra Edits Qwen Weights Directly, Boosting Math Accuracy 6x Without Training
content_en:
Researchers from MIT CSAIL have demonstrated a novel "weight-space programming" approach, allowing GPT-6 Astra to directly read and edit the weights of Qwen3.5-0.8B without traditional gradient descent or training loops. In benchmark tests on MATH-500, the modified model's average accuracy leaped from 7.9% to 48.1%—a nearly sixfold improvement.

The experiment provided Astra with a Python environment for weight manipulation and math exercise materials excluding test set questions. Allowed up to 50 forward calls to evaluate outputs and internal states, Astra modified only about 0.016% of the total parameters, focusing edits on specific MLP output columns in layers 15 and 19 to reduce repetitive reasoning loops.

Beyond MATH-500, the modified model achieved substantial gains across other benchmarks: GSM8K accuracy surged from 13.8% to 67.1%, while strict instruction-following accuracy on IFEval jumped from 21.0% to 62.3%. The research team has open-sourced the prompts, code, benchmarks, and weight diffs, alongside an online demo.

title_zh: OpenAI 用 Astra 一周设计语音 Codex 设备，并与马自达合作研究
content_zh:
OpenAI 公布一项硬件设计实验：两名团队成员利用 GPT-6 Astra，在不到一周的业余项目时间内完成一台可与 Codex 语音交互的设备设计，代工商随后用不到一个月制作出小批原型。

模型参与了外壳和内部结构设计、元件选择、PCB 布局与连线，以及界面、固件和 Codex 软件集成。进入制造阶段后，团队仍进行了多轮审查与迭代，解决模型未充分考虑的生产限制、公差与装配细节。

公司同时宣布与马自达开展研究合作，让模型辅助空气动力学和碰撞安全工程师设计、模拟及评估汽车方案。与 Chip Ganassi Racing 的合作则在探索将现有零件的 3D 扫描转换为可编辑 CAD 模型和二维制造图纸，输出由车队工程师检查准确性与可制造性。

在测试三维零件重建、装配和电路板连接识别的 BenchCAD 2.0 上，OpenAI 披露一款较新的内部模型平均得分为 0.875，GPT-6 Astra 最高推理档为 0.594。
title_en: OpenAI Unveils AI-Designed Voice Device and Partners with Mazda on Engineering
content_en:
OpenAI has showcased a hardware design experiment where two team members used GPT-6 Astra to design a voice-interactive Codex device in less than a week. A contract manufacturer subsequently produced a small batch of prototypes in under a month.

GPT-6 Astra assisted across multiple phases, including structural design, component selection, PCB routing, firmware, and software integration. Human engineers then conducted refinement rounds to address manufacturing constraints, tolerances, and assembly details overlooked by the model.

Additionally, OpenAI announced research partnerships with Mazda and Chip Ganassi Racing. Mazda engineers are using OpenAI models to assist with aerodynamics and crash safety simulations, while Chip Ganassi Racing is exploring converting 3D scans of existing components into editable CAD models and 2D engineering drawings.

OpenAI also shared benchmark results on BenchCAD 2.0, which tests 3D part reconstruction and PCB connection identification. GPT-6 Astra scored 0.594 in high-reasoning mode, while a newer unreleased internal model reached an average score of 0.875.

title_zh: 曝 DeepSeek V5 拟用昇腾预训练
content_zh:
《科创板日报》援引多名产业链人士消息称，DeepSeek 下一代大模型 V5 计划基于华为昇腾芯片进行预训练。此前，昇腾芯片主要承担 DeepSeek 模型的推理任务。

报道梳理，DeepSeek 于 9 月 30 日开源了面向昇腾的基础设施组件，包括 TileLang 编译工具、DeepGEMM 和 FlashMLA 等计算库，以及 DeepEP 分布式通信库，与此前面向英伟达平台的组件对应。

华为则提供联合定义的超节点及组网方案，并开放底层编程接口和指令支持。

在训练侧，深圳河套学院等团队此前已依托昇腾 910C 集群完成 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的全参数后训练；V5 传出的计划则涉及下一代模型的基础预训练。
title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Planning Next-Gen V5 Pre-Training on Huawei Ascend Chips
content_en:
DeepSeek plans to use Huawei Ascend AI chips for the base pre-training of its next-generation large language model, DeepSeek V5, according to industry sources cited by *STAR Market Daily*. Ascend chips were previously used primarily for inference workloads across DeepSeek's models.

The strategic shift follows DeepSeek's release of Ascend-compatible infrastructure software on September 30, including the TileLang compiler, DeepGEMM and FlashMLA math libraries, and the DeepEP distributed communication framework—matching tools previously available for Nvidia hardware.

Huawei is supplying co-defined supernode network architectures alongside low-level programming interfaces. While research teams had previously completed full-parameter post-training of DeepSeek-V4-Pro on Ascend 910C clusters, the V5 project will mark the first time Ascend chips are deployed for primary pre-training.

title_zh: 中兴否认出售手机业务传闻
content_zh:
针对中兴通讯拟与互联网大厂等合作成立合资公司、承接其手机业务的消息，中兴通讯 11 月 3 日向《科创板日报》回应称：「不属实。」

此前，雷峰网援引相关公司员工消息称，中兴正在与某互联网大厂商谈手机业务合作，方案涉及由中兴、该互联网大厂及上海国资共同成立合资公司。

报道所述资产范围为面向消费者的国内外手机业务，红魔手机业务不在拟打包范围内。
title_en: ZTE Denies Rumors of Selling Smartphone Business to Joint Venture
content_en:
ZTE Corporation has officially refuted reports claiming it plans to hand over its consumer smartphone business through a joint venture with a major internet company and local state capital.

Speaking to *Star Market Daily* on November 3, ZTE declared the reports "untrue." The denial follows a media report alleging that ZTE was negotiating to transfer its domestic and international consumer mobile unit—excluding its RedMagic gaming brand—to a newly formed entity backed by a tech giant and Shanghai state-owned capital.

title_zh: Claude Code 产品负责人 Cat Wu 离开 Anthropic
content_zh:
Claude Code 和 Cowork 的产品负责人 Cat Wu 今天在 X 发文称已离开 Anthropic，上周五是她在 Anthropic 的最后一天。

据她在文中回忆，两年前 Claude Code 还只是内部小工具时，她让它搭建一个 RL 环境。她花了几十个小时引导，但全程没有手动写过一行代码，最终任务完成，她也因此加入了团队。

她提到，产品刚推出时，多数用户会手动批准每一条权限提示，主要用 Claude 回答问题和编写测试。如今的默认做法是信任 Claude 的判断，让它自动批准，Claude 已能完成大型迁移，也能打造全新产品。她在帖文中感谢了 Claude Code、Cowork 和 Tag 背后的团队以及用户。

Cat Wu 早年在 Scale AI 和 Dagster 担任工程师，之后在风投机构 Index Ventures 工作，2024 年 8 月加入 Anthropic，起初负责研究方向的产品经理工作。
title_en: Claude Code Product Lead Cat Wu Announces Departure from Anthropic
content_en:
Cat Wu, the product lead behind Claude Code and Cowork, has announced her departure from Anthropic. In a post on X, Wu revealed that last Friday marked her final day at the AI research company.

Reflecting on her tenure, Wu recalled how Claude Code began as a simple internal tool two years ago, when she guided it to build a reinforcement learning environment without writing a single line of code. She highlighted the tool's rapid evolution from an assistant requiring manual approvals to an autonomous system capable of executing major codebase migrations and creating new products.

Wu joined Anthropic in August 2024 as a research product manager. Prior to Anthropic, she worked as a software engineer at Scale AI and Dagster, and later served as an investor at venture capital firm Index Ventures.

title_zh: 姚顺宇否认创业：仍是 Google DeepMind 员工
content_zh:
「我没有创办公司，目前仍是谷歌 DeepMind 的员工。」针对网传筹备递归自我改进（RSI）公司的消息，AI 研究员姚顺宇 11 月 2 日晚间向澎湃科技作出否认。这篇由记者喻琰采写的采访于 11 月 3 日发布。

此前传闻称，相关创业项目的联合创始团队已基本成形，并在吸引 Google DeepMind、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的人才。姚顺宇回应：「我完全不知道这个假消息是从哪里来的。」

这已是他近期第二次回应创业传言。10 月 12 日，他曾在社交平台表示，目前没有在中国融资的计划，并称自己「只是个普通的研究员」。
title_en: AI Researcher Shunyu Yao Denies Launching Startup, Remains at Google DeepMind
content_en:
AI researcher Shunyu Yao has debunked widespread rumors claiming he is leaving Google DeepMind to launch a startup focused on Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI).

In an interview published by *The Paper*, Yao confirmed that he has not founded a company and remains an employee at Google DeepMind, adding that he had no knowledge of where the false reports originated. Prior rumors alleged that Yao had assembled a founding team and was recruiting talent from OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepMind.

This marks the second time in recent weeks that Yao has addressed such speculation. In mid-October, he clarified on social media that he had no plans to raise funds in China, emphasizing that he is "just a regular researcher."

title_zh: 多所高校免费发 Token，同济每周提供 1 亿 Token
content_zh:
高校开始把 AI 使用额度纳入校园公共资源。据第一财经报道，中国科学技术大学、北京邮电大学、同济大学已先后向师生提供免费 Token 或算力账户。

中科大年中推出「词元计划」，面向全体在校师生提供每人每天 1 亿 Token，次日清零重置，可调用 DeepSeek、GLM 和千问等模型。

同济大学 10 月 26 日上线人工智能服务平台，为每位师生提供 AI 账号，每周发放 1000 积分，折合 1 亿 Token；平台整合模型调用、智能应用开发、实践教学和多模态生成。

北邮采用另一种方式：9 月上线的「人人有算力」平台为近万名本科和研究生新生开通免费账户，集成 10 余种大模型与智能体。

学生获得可自主配置的虚拟服务器环境，可直接调用已部署模型、开发智能体。
title_en: Chinese Universities Roll Out Free AI Tokens and Compute for Students
content_en:
Chinese universities are increasingly integrating artificial intelligence resources into public campus utilities, offering students free AI model tokens and computing power.

The University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) recently launched its "Token Plan," granting all students and faculty 100 million free tokens daily to access popular LLMs like DeepSeek, GLM, and Qwen. Similarly, Tongji University debuted an AI service platform providing each user with a weekly quota equivalent to 100 million tokens for model querying, app development, and multimodal generation.

Meanwhile, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT) has taken a compute-first approach. Its new platform provides nearly 10,000 freshmen with free virtual server environments pre-configured with over 10 AI models, enabling students to build and deploy intelligent agents directly.

title_zh: 蔚来累计换电突破 1.3 亿次，最近 1000 万次用时 88 天
content_zh:
蔚来宣布，11 月 3 日 18:53:21，累计换电次数突破 1.3 亿次，日均换电单量超过 11 万次。从第 1 次到第 1000 万次换电，蔚来用了 1506 天；从 1.2 亿次到 1.3 亿次，用时缩短至 88 天。

截至当天，蔚来在全国布局 4236 座换电站，其中 1077 座位于高速公路，连接 550 座城市，形成「9 纵 11 横 16 大城市群」高速换电网络。公司称，84.5% 的用户在居住地或工作地周边 3 公里内可找到至少一座换电站。

充电网络方面，蔚来另有 5556 座充电站、32261 根充电桩，累计建成充换电站 9792 座；已贯通 92 条加电风景线，计划年内达到 100 条。
title_en: NIO Surpasses 130 Million Battery Swaps as Adoption Accelerates
content_en:
Electric vehicle maker NIO reached a major operational milestone on November 3, surpassing 130 million cumulative battery swaps. The company now averages over 110,000 daily swaps across its network.

The pace of adoption has accelerated dramatically. While NIO took 1,506 days to achieve its first 10 million swaps, its most recent 10 million swaps took just 88 days.

To support this rapid growth, NIO has built 4,236 swap stations across China, including 1,077 along major highways. According to the company, 84.5% of its users now live or work within three kilometers of a swap station. Combined with its 5,556 charging stations, NIO's total charging and swapping infrastructure now comprises nearly 9,800 facilities nationwide.

title_zh: Seedance 海外收入占比达一半，腾讯与 B 站成为国内大客户
content_zh:
据《智能涌现》报道，字节跳动视频生成模型 Seedance 的海外收入占比已达 50%。接近火山引擎的人士称，过去半年，其海外收入增长近 5 倍。

国内市场的主力客户仍是互联网企业。报道援引知情人士消息称，按 Token 消耗和贡献收入衡量，腾讯位列 Seedance 中国区客户前三，B 站进入前十。

实体产业客户数量占比则已超过四分之一，覆盖制造、新零售、商业服务、教育、医疗健康、通信、汽车和能源等领域。

火山引擎今年成立了 FDE（前沿部署工程师）团队，深入汽车、医疗、教育等重点行业。总裁谭待曾在 6 月 FORCE 大会上表示，希望 Seedance 进入各行业的生产环境，特别是高端生产力制造。
title_en: ByteDance's Video AI Model Seedance Gains Global Traction and Major Domestic Clients
content_en:
Overseas markets now account for 50% of total revenue for Seedance, ByteDance's video generation AI model. Driven by strong international demand, Seedance's overseas revenue grew nearly fivefold over the past six months, according to tech outlet *AI Origin*.

In China, major tech enterprises remain the primary driver of token consumption and revenue. Gaming and social giant Tencent ranks among Seedance's top three domestic clients, while video platform Bilibili sits in the top ten.

Traditional industries are also adopting the model, with enterprise clients in manufacturing, retail, healthcare, and automotive now making up over a quarter of Seedance's client base. To further accelerate industrial adoption, ByteDance's cloud arm, Volcano Engine, has established a Forward Deployment Engineering team to integrate Seedance directly into mission-critical workflows.

title_zh: AMD 数据中心收入接近翻倍，第四季度营收指引达 170 亿美元
content_zh:
AMD 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收创纪录达到 134 亿美元，同比增长 45%，超过此前指引上限。GAAP 净利润为 24 亿美元，摊薄每股收益 1.46 美元；non-GAAP 净利润为 35 亿美元，摊薄每股收益 2.09 美元。

苏姿丰表示，随着 Helios 机架级方案和「Venice」产品扩大生产，预计第四季度增长将进一步加速。公司给出的第四季度营收指引为 170 亿美元、上下浮动 3%，中值对应同比增长约 66%，non-GAAP 毛利率预计约 55%。
title_en: AMD Reports Record Q3 Revenue and Projects $17 Billion Q4 Fueled by Data Center Growth
content_en:
AMD reported record financial results for its third quarter, delivering revenue of $13.4 billion—a 45% year-over-year increase that surpassed the upper bound of its previous guidance.

The chipmaker achieved a GAAP net profit of $2.4 billion ($1.46 per diluted share) and a non-GAAP net profit of $3.5 billion ($2.09 per diluted share).

Looking ahead, AMD Chair and CEO Lisa Su stated that growth is expected to accelerate further in the fourth quarter, driven by the production ramp-up of its Helios rack-level solutions and upcoming "Venice" processors. For Q4, AMD projects revenue to reach approximately $17 billion (±3%), representing roughly 66% year-over-year growth at the midpoint, alongside an estimated non-GAAP gross margin of around 55%.

title_zh: 💡 阿里董事会主席：只有开源才能普及 AI
content_zh:
在 11 月 3 日世界互联网大会乌镇峰会开幕式上，阿里巴巴董事会主席蔡崇信表示，开源能降低中小企业研发成本，对小语种和发展中国家尤其有价值。他认为，开源让更多地区能够参与 AI 发展，并可将模型部署在自己的数据中心。

蔡崇信以乌干达的一个非营利组织为例：该组织基于千问开发本地语言模型，已覆盖 68 种非洲语言，帮助当地用户跨越语言门槛。他表示，千问目前已开源超过 470 款模型，全球累计下载量突破 40 亿次，衍生模型超过 33 万个。

他还强调，开放应包括人才、想法、数据与工具的共享。阿里运营的魔搭社区已吸引全球 239 个国家和地区的 3300 万用户，参与者来自中国、美国、印度、东南亚、非洲和拉丁美洲等地区。

蔡崇信表示，AI 应用正在工业制造、医疗健康、公共服务、企业办公和科技研发等领域规模化，需求持续增加。中国企业选择开放模型与生态，是希望通过共享让更多人参与进来。对于下一阶段，他提出的议题包括如何更公平分享智能知识，以及如何共同解决 AI 伦理与治理问题。
title_en: Alibaba Chairman Joe Tsai Advocates Open-Source AI as Essential for Global Democratization
content_en:
Speaking at the opening of the World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit, Alibaba Group Chairman Joe Tsai emphasized that open-source architecture is vital to democratizing artificial intelligence. He highlighted how open-source models significantly lower R&D costs for small and medium-sized enterprises while delivering immense value to developing nations and minority language communities.

To illustrate this impact, Tsai cited an initiative in Uganda where a non-profit organization leveraged Alibaba's open-source Qwen model to develop local language processing capabilities covering 68 African languages. To date, Alibaba has open-sourced more than 470 Qwen models, reaching over 4 billion global downloads and spawning 330,000 derivative models. Furthermore, its ModelScope developer platform has attracted 33 million users across 239 countries and regions.

Tsai urged the global technology community to foster open sharing across talent, ideas, data, and tools. Moving forward, he called for collective efforts to address critical challenges around equitable knowledge distribution, AI ethics, and global governance.

title_zh: 英伟达与 Pika 基于 MiniMax H3 开源视频增强和生成模型
content_zh:
MiniMax H3 迎来两项外部开源项目：英伟达与 MIT 团队的 Open-H3-Regenerate-2K，以及 Pika 于 10 月 29 日发布的 H3 Flex。前者补上高分辨率视频重生成环节，后者面向更快的视频、声音联合生成。

Open-H3-Regenerate-2K 冻结 H3 主干与视频 VAE，通过细化 LoRA 和三步扩散重绘低分辨率草稿的细节。项目支持将 H3 或其他模型生成的草稿处理为 2K、原生 4K 等分辨率，单次可处理 5 至 15 秒视频。

Pika H3 Flex 将去噪从 50 步压至 6 步，开放生成适配权重和推理代码，覆盖文本生成视频、首尾帧生成及多模态参考生成，并同步生成音频。开放模型原生输出为 480p 或 768p；1080p、2K、4K 放大和音频分轨由 Pika 托管服务提供。
title_en: NVIDIA and Pika Launch Open-Source Video Models Powered by MiniMax H3
content_en:
MiniMax's H3 architecture has spurred two major open-source video generation projects: NVIDIA and MIT’s "Open-H3-Regenerate-2K," alongside Pika’s newly unveiled "H3 Flex." Both initiatives expand the capabilities of open-source video synthesis and upscaling.

Developed by NVIDIA and MIT, Open-H3-Regenerate-2K focuses on high-resolution video enhancement. By freezing the H3 backbone and video VAE while leveraging fine-tuned LoRA weights and a three-step diffusion process, the model restores fine details from low-resolution drafts. It supports upscaling draft inputs into native 2K and 4K resolutions for video clips ranging from 5 to 15 seconds.

Meanwhile, Pika’s H3 Flex accelerates multimodal generation by reducing denoising steps from 50 down to just 6. The open-source release supports text-to-video, frame interpolation, and multimodal reference generation accompanied by synchronized audio tracks. While native open-source outputs range between 480p and 768p, higher-resolution upscaling up to 4K is supported via Pika’s hosted service platform.

title_zh: 商汤发布 SenseNova 6.8 Flash，支持动态设计与可编辑 3D 工程
content_zh:
商汤于 11 月 2 日推出 SenseNova 6.8 Flash 正式版，围绕多步骤任务协作、长期记忆及设计交付进行更新。模型已上线 SenseNova Studio 和 Token Plan，商汤小浣熊也提供限时免费体验。

设计功能覆盖网页、SVG、Three.js、Blender 和 PPT，并可衔接 Figma 工作流。商汤称，模型可在生成 PPTX 时统筹转场、元素入场和图表动效；与 Blender 协作时，可根据实际渲染结果及用户反馈逐轮修改场景，输出可继续编辑的工程。这项动态 3D 演示依赖本地环境搭建和用户多轮交互。

商汤还展示了长期记忆与主动交互的办公案例：将新产品支持私有化部署的信息，与此前因不支持该功能而流失的客户需求关联，提醒销售重新跟进。该主动交互演示基于小浣熊内部测试版。
title_en: SenseTime Releases SenseNova 6.8 Flash Featuring Dynamic Design and Editable 3D Workflows
content_en:
SenseTime officially launched the production version of SenseNova 6.8 Flash on November 2, bringing major enhancements to multi-step task collaboration, long-term memory, and design delivery. The model is now available via SenseNova Studio and Token Plan, with free trial access offered through the SenseTime Raccoon assistant.

The model supports a wide array of design workflows—including web pages, SVG, Three.js, Blender, and PowerPoint—with native integration into Figma. In presentation design, SenseNova 6.8 Flash can coordinate slide transitions, element animations, and dynamic charts. When paired with Blender, it iteratively refines 3D scenes based on real-time render output and user feedback, generating fully editable project files.

Additionally, SenseTime showcased proactive office automation capabilities powered by long-term memory. In one demonstration, the system automatically identified previously lost leads and alerted sales reps to follow up after learning that a newly released product version added support for private deployment.

title_zh: 法拉利首款电动车 Luce，2027 年产量已全部被预订
content_zh:
法拉利 CEO Benedetto Vigna 在第三季度财报电话会上表示，公司首款电动车 Luce 的 2027 年生产配额已全部分配，新客户需要等待约一年才能提车。首批交付预计于第四季度开始。

据 TechCrunch 报道，这款五座电动车由前苹果设计主管 Jony Ive 操刀，5 月亮相时曾引发设计争议。Vigna 称，预订客户在类型和地域分布上都有良好组合，没有特定的人群模式。

法拉利尚未公开 Luce 的计划产量。公司在本次财报中还提到，个性化定制需求及限量超跑 F80 交付推动了业绩，定制业务已占汽车及零部件收入的逾两成。
title_en: Ferrari's Debut EV 'Luce' Sold Out Through 2027 Ahead of Initial Deliveries
content_en:
Ferrari CEO Benedetto Vigna announced during the company's Q3 earnings call that production allocations for its first fully electric vehicle, the Luce, are completely sold out through 2027. First deliveries are scheduled to begin in the fourth quarter, with new buyers facing a wait time of roughly one year.

Designed by former Apple chief designer Jony Ive, the five-seater EV drew significant industry attention upon its reveal in May. Vigna noted that current orders reflect a diverse mix of customer demographics and geographic regions, though Ferrari has not disclosed total planned production numbers for the vehicle.

The automaker also highlighted strong quarterly performance driven by growing demand for bespoke vehicle customization—which now accounts for over 20% of total car and spare parts revenue—alongside ongoing deliveries of the limited-edition F80 supercar.

title_zh: 美团 LongCat-2.5 正式发布，国产算力训练原生多模态模型
content_zh:
美团于 11 月 2 日正式发布 LongCat-2.5，面向需要持续执行的长程智能体任务。模型总参数量为 1.6 万亿，每个 Token 激活约 480 亿参数，强化了原生视觉理解和智能体编程能力。

新模型把图像转为多层级离散 Token，与文字交给同一主干模型处理，支持看图编程、创意设计和 3D 任务。训练任务来自 GitHub 公开仓库及内部真实代码场景，团队还将 Agent 的失败轨迹还原为可复现、带测试的任务，补强复杂代码库开发和完整项目构建能力。

训练和推理围绕国产 AI 加速卡优化。在美团测试的长序列监督微调任务中，单卡吞吐较 DDP 基线提升 86%；线上压测中，W4A4 量化相较 W8A8 基线，使预填充和解码吞吐分别提升 43.3% 和 42.77%。模型已提供在线体验和 API 接入。
title_en: Meituan Unveils LongCat-2.5: A 1.6-Trillion Parameter Multimodal Model Optimized for Domestic Chips
content_en:
Meituan officially launched LongCat-2.5 on November 2, designed specifically for complex, long-horizon AI agent workflows. Featuring a total of 1.6 trillion parameters—with 48 billion activated per token—the model offers enhanced native visual understanding and agent programming capabilities.

By converting images into hierarchical discrete tokens processed alongside text in a unified backbone, LongCat-2.5 supports visual coding, creative design, and 3D tasks. To boost performance in real-world development, the team trained the model on GitHub repositories, internal production code, and converted agent failure logs into reproducible, testable tasks.

Built and optimized specifically for domestic AI acceleration hardware, the model achieved an 86% single-card throughput improvement in long-sequence fine-tuning over DDP baselines. Under online stress tests with W4A4 quantization, prefill and decoding throughput rose by 43.3% and 42.77% respectively compared to W8A8 benchmarks. LongCat-2.5 is now accessible via web interface and API.

title_zh: 智能投影销量连跌四季，第三季度中国市场下滑 26.2%
content_zh:
据界面新闻援引洛图科技 11 月 3 日发布的数据，2026 年第三季度中国智能投影市场销量为 82.9 万台，同比下降 26.2%；销售额为 12.3 亿元，同比下滑 27.1%。统计不含激光电视，市场已连续四个季度同比下滑，各季跌幅均超过 20%。

市场收缩的同时，线上品牌集中度上升。第三季度销量前十品牌的合计份额达 74%，销额前十品牌合计占 81.7%。极米位居线上销量、销额双榜第一，大眼橙销量第二、康佳第三；坚果则位居销额第二。

洛图科技还将全年零售量预测下调至 385.7 万台，同比下降 25.9%；预计全年销额为 62.8 亿元，同比下降 24.8%。
title_en: China Smart Projector Sales Plunge 26.2% in Q3, Marking Four Quarters of Decline
content_en:
China's smart projector market continued its downward spiral in the third quarter, with sales volume dropping 26.2% year-over-year to 829,000 units, according to data from RUNTO Technology. Market revenue fell 27.1% to 1.23 billion yuan. This marks the fourth consecutive quarter of decline, with each period experiencing drops of over 20%. The statistics do not include laser TVs.

Despite the overall market contraction, brand concentration among online sellers increased. The top ten online brands accounted for 74% of total sales volume and 81.7% of total revenue. XGIMI led the market in both volume and sales value, followed by Orange and Konka in volume, and JMGO in sales value.

In light of the weak performance, RUNTO lowered its full-year retail market forecast to 3.857 million units, representing a 25.9% year-over-year decrease. Full-year sales revenue is projected to drop 24.8% to 6.28 billion yuan.

title_zh: 佳能计划明年起调价，应对零部件成本上涨
content_zh:
佳能在 2026 年第三季度分析师问答中表示，公司正设法确保明年所需的紧缺零部件供应，预计采购成本将上升，计划从 2027 年起通过提高售价抵消成本增长。公司会综合考虑销量与盈利，作出长期价格决策。

原始问答还区分了各业务的供应状况：打印和影像业务也面临零部件短缺，但因提前应对，尚未受到重大影响；医疗业务则因生产系统更新后的运营问题，未能及时下单采购足量零部件，预计到明年第二季度才能取得满足当前生产计划的供应。

佳能预计，明年的内存和原材料价格不会下降，相关成本将影响全年经营。
title_en: Canon Plans Price Hikes to Offset Rising Component Costs
content_en:
Canon plans to raise product prices to offset increasing procurement costs caused by persistent component shortages, according to its third-quarter analyst Q&A session. The company aims to make long-term pricing adjustments starting in 2027 while balancing sales volume and profitability.

Supply chain challenges vary across Canon's business segments. While early procurement efforts helped minimize the impact on its printing and imaging divisions, the medical division faced procurement delays due to operational issues following a recent production system update. Component supply for medical equipment is not expected to fully meet current production targets until the second quarter of next year.

Canon anticipates that prices for raw materials and memory components will remain high throughout next year, placing continuous pressure on the company's annual operating performance.

title_zh: 全国放心消费平台上线，扫码可查周边商家承诺
content_zh:
市场监管总局 11 月 3 日正式上线全国放心消费平台，消费者搜索「消费查」小程序或扫描线下放心消费码即可进入。平台会按定位展示周边商家，首批已有超 1 万个放心消费单元、100 个放心消费集聚区入驻。

商家注册、在线承诺并经核验公示后，可获得「一店一码」的放心消费码和全国统一标识。平台首批已对接百度地图、美团外卖、淘宝闪购和京东外卖，让同一商家的标识在多个入口展示。

消费者可在商家主页查看证照、门店实景、售后方式、消费承诺和评价，也能一键导航、评价或电话联系商家。对发生违法失信行为、拒不履行承诺或推诿合理诉求的商家，监管部门查实后将责令其退出平台，并收回线下消费码与标识。
title_en: China Launches National 'Worry-Free Consumption' Platform to Boost Merchant Transparency
content_en:
China's State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) launched a national 'Worry-Free Consumption' platform on November 3. Consumers can locate verified nearby businesses by using a mini-program or scanning dedicated QR codes displayed at physical storefronts. Over 10,000 retail entities and 100 commercial hubs have joined the platform in the first phase.

After registering and publicly submitting their consumer commitments, verified merchants receive a unique storefront QR code and a standardized national emblem. The platform has partnered with major consumer apps—including Baidu Maps, Meituan, Taobao, and JD.com—allowing merchant trust badges to be displayed across multiple digital channels.

Through the merchant profile, consumers can review business licenses, store photos, service policies, and customer reviews, as well as make calls or request directions. SAMR emphasized that merchants engaging in dishonest practices, breaching commitments, or ignoring reasonable consumer grievances will be removed from the platform and stripped of their official badges.

title_zh: 《好莱坞往事》衍生片再请《社交网络》配乐搭档
content_zh:
Trent Reznor 与 Atticus Ross 将为大卫·芬奇的新片《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》配乐，这是两人与芬奇在电影上的第六次合作。新海报公布了配乐阵容，影片将于 11 月 25 日在 IMAX 独家上映两周，12 月 23 日上线 Netflix。

影片由昆汀·塔伦蒂诺编剧，是《好莱坞往事》的衍生作品，故事发生在前作八年后，围绕布拉德·皮特饰演的 Cliff Booth 展开。演员还包括伊丽莎白·德比茨基、卡拉·古奇诺和蒂莫西·奥利芬特等。

Reznor 与 Ross 从 2010 年《社交网络》开始为芬奇电影配乐，并凭该片获得奥斯卡最佳原创配乐奖；此后合作延续至《龙纹身的女孩》《消失的爱人》《曼克》和《杀手》。
title_en: Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross Reunite with David Fincher for Quentin Tarantino's 'Cliff Booth' Spinoff
content_en:
Oscar-winning composers Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross are set to score David Fincher’s upcoming film, *The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth*. The news was unveiled alongside a new poster, marking the duo's sixth cinematic collaboration with Fincher.

Written by Quentin Tarantino, the movie serves as a spinoff to *Once Upon a Time in Hollywood*. Set eight years after the events of the original film, the story centers on Brad Pitt’s character, Cliff Booth, with a supporting cast that includes Elizabeth Debicki, Carla Gugino, and Timothy Olyphant.

The film will debut with an exclusive two-week theatrical run in IMAX on November 25 before streaming globally on Netflix on December 23.

Reznor and Ross first partnered with Fincher on 2010's *The Social Network*, winning an Academy Award for Best Original Score. Their ongoing creative partnership has since yielded acclaimed soundtracks for *The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo*, *Gone Girl*, *Mank*, and *The Killer*.

title_zh: 《蓝眼武士》第二季定档明年 1 月，复仇之旅转向伦敦
content_zh:
Netflix 宣布，《蓝眼武士》（Blue Eye Samurai）第二季将于 2027 年 1 月 19 日上线，共六集。混血剑客 Mizu 的旅程将从江户时代的日本延伸至伦敦，继续寻找另两名可能是她父亲的男子。

主创 Amber Noizumi 和 Michael Green 表示，新一季设定在 1657 年的伦敦，Mizu 将进入当地的地下世界，并面对身为亚洲女性在当时英国社会的处境。两人称，团队花了三年时间研究并绘制这些历史场景。

Maya Erskine 继续为 Mizu 配音，新增配音演员包括 Jonathan Pryce、Joel Kim Booster 和 Sherry Cola。Netflix 同时确认，这段故事将在 2028 年迎来终章。
title_en: 'Blue Eye Samurai' Season 2 Sets 2027 Premiere as Mizu's Quest Moves to London
content_en:
Netflix has officially announced that the second season of *Blue Eye Samurai* will premiere on January 19, 2027. The six-episode season follows mixed-race swordmaster Mizu as her quest for vengeance shifts from Edo-period Japan to London, where she continues hunting for two men who could be her father.

Set in 1657 London, the new season follows Mizu as she dives into the city's criminal underworld and navigates the challenges of being an Asian woman in 17th-century Britain. Co-creators Amber Noizumi and Michael Green revealed that their team spent three years researching and designing the historical setting.

Maya Erskine returns to voice Mizu, joined by new voice cast members Jonathan Pryce, Joel Kim Booster, and Sherry Cola. Netflix also confirmed that the acclaimed animated series will conclude its story arc in 2028.

title_zh: Netflix 测试 AI Discover，按心情找片还能屏蔽不想看的推荐
content_zh:
Netflix 宣布在电视 App 中测试新栏目 AI Discover，先向美国使用英语、设备受支持的少量会员开放，并将在未来几周逐步扩大范围。

首批体验围绕主题找片：用户可以从「轻松一点」「吓吓我」「家庭电影夜」或「短时间观看」等主题进入，查看匹配片单，再选择更细的主题继续缩小范围，或用「换些不一样的」获得新推荐。

每部作品旁会新增调整推荐按钮，与播放、加入片单并列。用户可以保留该推荐，或要求以后不再推荐这部作品；AI Discover 会记住反馈，减少重复出现。

Netflix 表示，这一栏目由新的智能层驱动，会根据会员输入实时调整。公司将据使用情况和反馈决定保留、改进哪些体验，部分功能也可能进入主界面。
title_en: Netflix Tests 'AI Discover' Feature to Match Content with User Moods and Filter Recommendations
content_en:
Netflix has begun testing a new feature called "AI Discover" on its TV app, designed to help subscribers find movies and shows based on their mood and specific viewing preferences. Currently available to a select group of English-speaking subscribers in the U.S., the feature will expand to more users in the coming weeks.

The initial rollout lets users browse content through thematic hubs such as "Lighthearted," "Scare Me," "Family Movie Night," or "Quick Watch." Viewers can further narrow down their choices by selecting sub-topics or tapping "Try Something Else" to refresh their suggestions.

To give users greater control over their recommendations, Netflix is adding a feedback option alongside the play and watchlist buttons. Subscribers can choose to save a recommendation or block a title from appearing again, allowing the AI to learn their preferences and reduce repetitive suggestions.

Powered by a real-time intelligence layer, AI Discover adapts dynamically based on user input. Netflix plans to refine the feature based on engagement and feedback, with the potential to integrate popular elements into the main homepage interface.

title_zh: 三周年倒计时｜人人都爱贴贴线
content_zh:
距离制糖工厂贴贴线三周年，还有 1 天。

三年前，为了解决数据线容易缠绕、收纳麻烦的小问题，第一根会自己磁吸的线——MagTie 贴贴线诞生了。三年里，从贴贴线到云朵线、花线、细雳线、细雳线 Pro 和贴贴卷，这个家族逐渐有了不同的模样：更柔软、更有个性、更高速，也有更省空间的选择。不变的，是让日常连接更顺手的想法。

三周年之际，我们也想听听：你最喜欢哪一款，又和它一起度过了哪些日常？欢迎分享你的贴贴故事，一起迎接三周年，蹲蹲重磅福利！
title_en: CANDYSIGN Celebrates 3 Years of MagTie: Redefining Everyday Connectivity
content_en:
With just one day left until its 3rd anniversary, CANDYSIGN is looking back at the journey of MagTie—the innovative self-magnetic cable designed three years ago to solve the daily headache of tangled cords and messy storage.

Over the past three years, the MagTie lineup has evolved into a diverse family of products, including the Cloud Cable, Floral Cable, Slim Cable, Slim Cable Pro, and MagTie Roll. Across all iterations—whether softer, bolder in personality, faster in data transfer, or more space-efficient—CANDYSIGN's core vision has remained unchanged: making everyday connectivity smoother and more intuitive.

To mark this milestone, CANDYSIGN is inviting fans to share their favorite MagTie models and personal stories, teasing major perks and exclusive giveaways as the anniversary celebration kicks off.
